basic_info.description: Seller will look at all Offers. Location, Location Location! Situated in the Heart of  Nob Hill on Washington at Van Ness, this home has it all. Constructed in 2017, this 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom condo features an open living, kitchen, and dining room with a wonderful wrap around terrace. The bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom and in-unit laundry. The well appointed kitchen features quartz counters and Bertazzoni appliances. Take the elevator to the fantastic roof deck offering multiple vantage points of the city and multiple seating areas. One parking space and a sizeable storage locker complete this wonderful home. With a secured entrance on Washington Street, you are only minutes away from the Polk Street corridor, Russian Hill, and Pacific Heights. City dwellers will love the multiple transit and shuttle stops as well as the 99 walkscore.The building's shared rooftop terrace provides panoramic city and Bay views, a glass-enclosed lounge, and an outdoor dining area.
